evidence: Rutherford backscattering spectrometry was performed using a spectrometer purchased from NEC and equipped with a MAS 1700 end station. Ellipsometry at a 70° incident angle where λ = 6328 Å was used to measure the film thickness and refractive index simultaneously at three or more locations on each wafer. X-ray diffraction measurements were carried out using a Siemens D5005 X-ray diffractometer. Surface roughness was measured with an atomic force microscope (Digital Instruments Nanoscope III). The cross-sectional SEM backscattered electron image was collected on an Hitachi S-900 scanning electron microscope. Low-angle X-ray scattering measurements were carried out at the 2-BM bending magnet beamline of the Advanced Photon Source (APS).
